messages:
matt: FYI PR #22000 is failing CI — snapshot mismatch in rendering/test_component on macos only. Can someone take a quick look?
ci-bot: build 22000.3 failed on macos-11, test: RenderingSnapshotTest::ButtonVariantAssertion
ci-bot: ```
AssertionError: images differ by 1 pixel
  at compareImages (tests/snapshot_utils.js:42:12)
  at RenderingSnapshotTest.render (tests/rendering.test.js:128:8)
```
anya: ugh, mac snapshots again. I can dig in. matt, did this touch fonts or styles?
matt: only minor css tweak for button padding, shouldn't affect pixels but possible on mac font metrics.
jeremy: re-ran job 22000.3 (just the mac shard) -> https://ci.internal/22000/3 :rerun:
ci-bot: rerun complete — macos-11 still failing (same diff).
sophia: quick idea — last time a 1px diff was font hinting on mac when running inside vm. Can we run the failing test locally on macos runner or add tolerance? :thinking:
olivia: I don't have a mac to repro. If it's a known flake from font rendering, maybe update the comparator to allow 1px diff for this component?
anya: I'd prefer not to update comparator globally. Alternative: run an isolated job with headless chromium flags `--disable-font-subpixel-positioning` to see if it changes. I'll kick one off.
ci-bot: launched targeted job 22000.mac-debug (isolated runner)
ci-bot: targeted job finished — still failing, diff shows consistent 1px offset on left edge.
sophia: given it's consistent, sounds like a real regression from padding change. We should either update the snapshot or revert the padding tweak. Any objections to snapshot update? :eyes:
jeremy: I'd lean to fix test robustness, but small UI tweak was intentional. If the visual change is expected, update snapshot with a small note in PR. Who can approve snapshot updates for core/ui?
matt: I don't have approver perms for core/ui snapshots. @anya or @sophia can approve.
anya: I can approve after a confirm on linux. Can you run linux and windows shards targeted?
ci-bot: launched targeted jobs: 22000.linux-debug, 22000.win-debug
ci-bot: results — linux passed, windows passed, mac failed.
olivia: since mac is only failing, and the change is intended, I'm OK updating the mac snapshot. I'll add a line in the PR description: "Update mac snapshot due to button padding tweak; confirmed on linux/windows."
sophia: fine from me. jeremy, do you want to add comparator tolerance as a follow-up?
jeremy: yes — I'll open a small PR to add a 1px tolerance for non-critical UI shadows so we reduce noise.
matt: sounds good. For now snapshot update is approved by anya and sophia. matt: holding merge until the snapshot is updated and CI green. :lock:
anya: I will push the snapshot update to the branch in a minute.
ci-bot: note: when updating snapshots, use `yarn test:update --filter rendering/test_component` and include screenshot artifacts in the PR.
olivia: pinging @frontend-oncall to eyeball if needed. :wave:
matt: thanks all — please comment in the PR when done and I'll merge once pipeline is green.
